fields.formula: {Hours included per month} - {Hours used this month}

fields.label: Hours used (%)
fields.formula: IF({Hours included per month} > 0, ROUND({Hours used this month} / {Hours included per month} * 100, 0), 0)

fields.formula: IF({Hours used this month} > {Hours included per month}, "Over the included hours", IF({Hours used this month} >= {Hours included per month} * 0.8, "Close to the limit", "Within hours"))

text.text: Clients, retainers, projects, capacity and proposals together. Check the retainers for hours used and the capacity table before accepting new work.
The report is what keeps a retainer renewed. Clients rarely ask for it, but they notice the month it is missing.
How to build it in ten minutes
Open the retainer row and read Hours used this month and Hours left this month.
Open the Time this month view and list the three biggest pieces of work.
Write two lines on what is next and what you need decided.
Say so before the month ends, with the number. Offer either to move the extra work to next month or to bill it at the agreed rate; never let the client find out from an invoice.
